title: Leverage Trading with Market/Limit Orders on Minswap

ms.promise:
・System architecture documents and flow diagrams.
・A complete UI/UX prototype in Figma covering the entire leverage trading user journey. The design will include all main screens such as position opening/closing with market orders, position monitoring, take profit/stoploss and liquidation flows.
・This prototype will serve as the visual foundation for the frontend development stage
ms.criteria:
・Complete architecture design of the leverage protocol (borrow–swap–repay flows, UTXO design).
・The Figma prototype must be internally reviewed and approved by the project team for completeness, clarity, and usability.
・All core use cases must be represented : wallet connect → open/close position → Take Profit/Stop Loss → liquidation → monitoring.
